title: Chalo Himachal
description: Ten days in Himachal with a group of solo travellers: Old Manali cafés, Solang and the Atal Tunnel, a riverside camp in Kasol and a tandem paragliding day in Bir. Volvo both ways from Delhi, a trip captain throughout.

stories.title: 10 strangers, one Volvo, and the best paragliding day of my life
stories.body: We met at Majnu ka Tilla at 18:30 and by Manali everyone had a nickname. Bir was the day: Sanjay took me off the launch at Billing and I landed laughing. Kasol riverside camp the night after was the quiet bit we all needed.

stories.title: What I packed (and didn't need) for 10 days
stories.body: One 40 L bag, two fleeces, zero jeans. The thermos was the MVP. Full list below, with what I'd leave at home next time.

title: Kheerganga Trek
description: A short Parvati Valley trek from Barshaini through pine forest to the Kheerganga hot springs. Good first trek: 12 km up, camping at the top, back down on day three.

title: Rishikesh Weekend
description: Two days by the Ganga: rafting from Shivpuri, the evening aarti at Triveni Ghat and a riverside camp with a bonfire. Leaves Delhi Friday night, back Sunday night.

stories.title: Rafting, Ganga aarti and 9 new friends
stories.body: Day 1 we were 10 strangers on a Volvo. By the aarti on Saturday we had a group chat called “Ganga gang” and a plan for Kasol in December.

title: Rupin Pass Trek
description: A classic crossing from Uttarakhand into Himachal: hanging villages, the Rupin waterfall and snowfields at 4,650 m. For trekkers with at least one high-altitude trek behind them.

title: Brahmatal Trek
description: A winter trek with views of Trishul and Nanda Ghunti, a frozen alpine lake and snow camping. Moderate difficulty, ideal for a first snow trek.

title: Tungnath & Chandrashila
description: The highest Shiva temple in the world and a sunrise summit at Chandrashila. Easy-moderate walking, camping in the Chopta meadows.

stories.title: Sunrise at Chandrashila was worth every switchback
stories.body: Started the climb from Tungnath at 4:30 with head torches. Nanda Devi turned pink right as we reached the top. Chopta's maggi stalls are now my favourite restaurants in India.

title: Spiti Winter Expedition
description: Spiti under snow: Kaza, Key monastery, Langza and Chicham bridge, staying in warm village homestays. Via Shimla and Reckong Peo because Kunzum is closed.

title: Bhutan Explorer
description: Paro, Thimphu and Punakha with a licensed Bhutanese guide: the Tiger's Nest hike, Punakha Dzong and the Dochula pass. SDF and permits handled for you.

title: Valley of Flowers
description: A monsoon trek into the UNESCO valley at peak bloom, with an optional climb to Hemkund Sahib. Two nights in Ghangaria.

title: Kasol Riverside Hostel
description: Dorms and private rooms a short walk from Kasol market, right on the Parvati. Common room with a fireplace, café open till late, lockers for every bed.

title: Kalga Orchard Homestay
description: A family homestay inside an apple orchard in Kalga, 20 minutes' walk from Barshaini. Home-cooked Himachali meals and a sun deck facing the valley.

title: Tosh Cliffside Cottage
description: A wooden cottage at the top of Tosh village with a balcony over the glacier valley. Sleeps four, with a wood stove and a small kitchen.

title: Ganga Rafting, Shivpuri to Rishikesh
description: 16 km of grade III rapids from Shivpuri to Rishikesh with certified guides, including cliff jumping when the river allows.

title: Bir Billing Tandem Paragliding
description: A 15–25 minute tandem flight from Billing, one of the world's best launch sites, landing in Bir. GoPro video included.

title: Chopta Meadow Camping
description: Two days in the Chopta meadows with a short hike to Deoria Tal and a night under the stars with a bonfire.

title: Royal Enfield Himalayan · Manali
description: Royal Enfield Himalayan 411 with helmets, a tool kit and permits help for Rohtang and Atal Tunnel. Pick up in Old Manali.

title: Scooty on rent · Kasol
description: Activa or Jupiter scooters for getting around Kasol, Manikaran and Barshaini. Pick up near the main market.
